summary: Submitted a research handoff product: a map refresh (map-v12.json, base version 11) plus sourced feedback, with preflight returning valid:true. Content: the deferred surface 'Raft.installSnapshot on the follower (commit context)' is replaced by its answered disposition (mapped, associated with b-install-snapshot and b-client-apply-verify, sourced to the install/commit-index/snapshot materials) and an additive surface 'NewRaft startup restoreSnapshot (commit context)' is recorded beside it (mapped, associated with b-newraft-recovery and b-client-apply-verify), so the overview no longer lists as unread a path that has been checked; no fact, behaviour, activity or core-path object changes and no repaired result is claimed. The feedback answers the commit-context question for both investigated entry points, citing the two retained CheckRuns: on the runtime path an InstallSnapshot at index 43 left the receiver publishing commit_index 0 with applied_index and last_index 43 (check d3999c33daf64a04949efbadb3e6f5e2), and on the recovery path the same node reconstructed over its own stores reported restored true and last_snapshot_index 43 while publishing commit_index 0 with applied_index and last_index 43 (check 6c982b1fcb114ff7b3e4b22ace5a238b); both were confirmed after review with no open issue, and in both the value is the one Raft.CommitIndex() and Stats publish. Remaining discriminators stay visible: the open repair location for both entry points, the unestablished external consumer of a follower's or restarted node's commit index, the still-deferred third-party SetHeartbeatHandler surface (the confirmed term regression covers only the two shipped transports), the deferred MonotonicLogStore/snapshot-compaction surface, and the unread nested modules fuzzy/ and raft-compat/. Run state at this point: nine confirmed in-scope findings, three audit units, 22 experiments, 12 semantic reviews and about 17 minutes remaining.
